// Generate HTML QTO Report const qto = $input.first().json; const timestamp = new Date().toISOString(); const html = ` BTI QTO Report

📊 BTI Quantity Take-Off Report

Generated: ${new Date(timestamp).toLocaleString('ru-RU')}

Total Area

${qto.total_area.toFixed(2)}
m²

Total Perimeter

${qto.total_perimeter.toFixed(2)}
m

Windows

${qto.windows_count}
units

Doors

${qto.doors_count}
units

📋 Entities by Layer

${Object.entries(qto.entities_by_layer).map(([layer, data]) => ` `).join('')}
Layer Name Count Total Area (m²) Total Perimeter (m)
${layer} ${data.count} ${data.area.toFixed(2)} ${data.perimeter.toFixed(2)}

🏗️ Entities by Type

${Object.entries(qto.entities_by_type).map(([type, data]) => ` `).join('')}
Entity Type Count Total Area (m²)
${type} ${data.count} ${data.area.toFixed(2)}
${qto.rooms.length > 0 ? `

🏠 Rooms Summary

${qto.rooms.map(room => ` `).join('')}
Room Name Area (m²) Perimeter (m)
${room.name} ${room.area.toFixed(2)} ${room.perimeter.toFixed(2)}
` : ''}

BTI DWG QA Pipeline v1.0 | Generated automatically with n8n

`; return [{ json: { html_content: html } }];

parameters.content:
## 📊 BTI QTO Generator

**Calculated Metrics:**
- Total area (m²)
- Total perimeter (m)
- Windows count
- Doors count
- Entities by layer
- Entities by type
- Room summaries

**Output**: Beautiful HTML report

## ⚙️ CONFIGURATION

**Set paths:**

1. `xlsx_file_path`
   Converted DWG data

2. `output_report_path`
   Where to save HTML report

**Report auto-opens in browser**
